description: Built-in low-ceremony task lifecycle workflow for atomic wrkf actions (triage, implement, verify, review). One forward transition per semantic action; no evidence/SoD gates.

triager.description: Triages the task and records the triage result.

implementer.description: Implements the task and records the implementation result.

tester.description: Verifies the task and records the verification result.

reviewer.description: Reviews the task and records the review result.

system.description: System effect adapter and administrative workflow authority.

states.description: Task is attached to the simple workflow and awaiting triage.
Triage is complete; implementation may begin.
Implementation is complete; verification may begin.
Verification is complete; review may begin.

triage_result.description: Output/proof produced by a triage action.

implement_result.description: Output/proof produced by an implement action.

verify_result.description: Output/proof produced by a verify action.

review_result.description: Output/proof produced by a review action.

failure_result.description: Output/proof produced by a failed action.

transitions.description: Triage is complete. If a specification was produced, move the task to ready; otherwise block the task (blocked is a wrkq task.state set via effect — no new workflow state) and hold the workflow at intake for re-triage.

outcomes.description: Specification produced; implementation may proceed. Normalize the wrkq task state to open so a worker start-reflex in_progress does not survive triage, and a previously blocked task is unblocked on successful re-triage.
No specification produced; block the task for clarification and hold the workflow at intake.

transitions.description: Implementation is complete. Branch on the run-linked implement_result evidence facts: a `done` disposition advances to implemented; a `blocked` disposition rewinds to ready and blocks the wrkq task (task.state set via effect). Callers that supply no disposition fact preserve the original unconditional advance to implemented via `otherwise`.

outcomes.description: Implementation reported done; verification may proceed. Selected from the just-written implement_result evidence facts (impl.disposition=done).

Implementation reported blocked; rewind the task to ready and block the wrkq task (blocked is a wrkq task.state set via effect — no new workflow state). Selected from the just-written implement_result evidence facts (impl.disposition=blocked).
Implementation recorded; verification may proceed. Preserves the original unconditional behavior for callers that complete without disposition facts.

transitions.description: Verification is complete. Branch on the run-linked verify_result evidence facts: a `verified` disposition closes the task as done and marks the wrkq task completed (task.state set via effect); a `blocked` disposition rewinds to ready and blocks the wrkq task. Callers that supply no disposition fact preserve the original unconditional advance to reviewing via `otherwise`.

outcomes.description: Verification reported verified; close the task as done and mark the wrkq task completed (task.state set via effect). Selected from the just-written verify_result evidence facts (verify.disposition=verified).

Verification reported blocked; rewind the task to ready and block the wrkq task (blocked is a wrkq task.state set via effect — no new workflow state). A failed verification invalidates the implementation claim. Selected from the just-written verify_result evidence facts (verify.disposition=blocked).
Verification recorded; review may proceed. Preserves the original unconditional behavior for callers that complete without disposition facts.

transitions.description: Review is complete; close the task.
